papers.title: L2C2: Enhancing Large-scale Chiplets for Agent Long-Context LLM Inference with Sparse and Distributed Attention
papers.abstract: Long-context inference is a rising demand for LLMs, especially for agent applications. Sparse attention (SpAt) and chiplet technology are promising solutions to reduce computations and scale hardware performance. However, deploying SpAt on distributed chiplets necessitates context parallelism for workload partitioning, introducing complex distributed attention. In this work, we present L2C2, a system optimization for distributed SpAt in long-context inference. During the partial-prefill stage, we propose a novel Split-Comm Attention mechanism that leverages the high-bandwidth interconnect of chiplets to trade communication overhead for reduced memory access. We combine it with conventional Ring Attention to form a Bi-Mode method that adapts to varying input sequence lengths. During the decoding stage, we analyze the cause of memory access imbalance and address it by static interleaved token assignment. Dynamic agile cache balancing is also proposed to adapt to SpAt skewness. Evaluations show our optimization can achieve 1.45$\times$ and 1.53$\times$ speedup in partial-prefill and decoding with SpAt on large-scale chiplets.

digest.summaryZh: L2C2 针对长上下文稀疏注意力的多chiplet执行，在部分预填充用Split-Comm与Ring双模式平衡通信和KV访存，解码时结合交错分配与动态缓存迁移。模拟报告部分预填充、解码分别1.45与1.53倍加速；收益依赖序列长度和互连条件，尚非流片实测。
digest.motivationZh: 长上下文稀疏注意力在多chiplet上下文并行中，仍受重复KV访问和不同分片的访问偏斜限制。Ring Attention偏重通信重叠，可能重复读同一KV块；连续token分配也可能把稀疏热点集中到少数存储分片。减少注意力计算后，访存、互连与负载均衡决定能否把分片数量转化为吞吐。直接对应稀疏KV管理、LLM加速器与chiplet存储层次，适合研究分布式注意力的数据搬运与核心空闲利用。
digest.methodZh: 按阶段优化分布式稀疏注意力：部分预填充在Split-Comm和Ring间选择，解码用交错KV分配与小规模动态迁移均衡。先分发Q并合并选择相同KV块的查询，再聚合局部注意力，减少跨步重复读。按新输入和缓存长度选择双模式，避免大输入时通信无法隐藏的负收益。静态交错token布局分散热点，并利用低负载分片空闲窗口迁移热块。采用ASTRA-sim/NS3、Ramulator2.0及Timeloop建模；默认8×8 die阵列、HP=8/CP=8，属于体系结构模拟与运行时协同，不是实体chiplet芯片实测。利用高速片间互连把部分不可重叠通信换成KV复用，并将静态分散与每轮小粒度迁移结合。

papers.title: Shared-Harmonic Characterization and Robust Orientation-Selection Certification for Directional Sensing Under Anisotropic Target Motion
papers.abstract: Directional sensors are often oriented using historical target trajectories, while future trajectories remain uncertain at deployment. This letter addresses two post-placement questions: i) when orientation materially affects detection and ii) when a historically selected orientation remains reliable under future target-motion shift. We develop a placement-aware framework for anisotropy-induced detection (AID), showing that orientation sensitivity is governed by harmonic modes shared by the locally visible target-direction distribution and the sensor trajectory-incidence response. The resulting AID measure admits an exact RMS interpretation for the retained-harmonic orientation response. We then introduce a sensor-induced directional discrepancy, derive a conditional bound on future orientation regret, and obtain sufficient certificates for robust orientation selection whenever the future sensor-relevant shift lies within a prescribed discrepancy radius. Using 2025 AIS ship-traffic data near Terrebonne Bay, Louisiana, historical AID is strongly correlated with held-out orientation sensitivity ($r=0.908$). Across four angular-response widths, AID explains orientation-sensitivity variation with $R^2=0.920$, compared with $R^2=0.239$ for target-only anisotropy. At the nominal threshold, 316 of 350 locations are empirically classified as orientation-useful, and all retain gain above the threshold across five held-out windows.

papers.title: The black hole IR triangle for scalar QED
papers.abstract: We construct the black hole infrared triangle of scalar QED on a stretched Schwarzschild horizon at tree level. In the covariant phase space of the near-horizon Maxwell field, the soft charge is a corner term. The memory is the zero mode of the gauge-invariant radiative field along the generators. It is conjugate to the boundary gauge mode that labels the degenerate horizon vacua, and Gauss' law fixes it by the flux of charge through the horizon. The Noether flux of the residual gauge transformation through the stretched horizon is not conserved by the scattering, because charged matter crosses the stretched horizon in both directions. The flux with its matter part removed is the soft charge, which generates the large gauge transformation. Its Ward identity is equivalent to a soft photon theorem in every radiative partial wave, which we derive from the near-horizon Feynman rules and, where these do not control the emission, from the field equations at leading order. The main difference from null infinity is that on a stretched horizon both radial branches of the field are independent boundary data. The hard charge is a radial flux. With both branches present it weights each leg by the direction of its radial motion, and the soft factor is a sign per leg. The endpoint data on the two branches give two boundary observables, the time-integrated transverse magnetic and electric fields. The field radiated by a scattering process contributes only to the first, where it cancels the change in the Coulomb memory of the charges, so that the soft charge is conserved. A charge that crosses the horizon enters both. We also discuss the infrared divergence, the dressing of the external states, and the fate of the memory in the Hartle--Hawking state, where it performs a random walk driven by the Hawking radiation.

papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Tensor Train Spectral Solver for High-Resolution PDEs with Non-Periodic Boundary Conditions
papers.abstract: Tensor train (TT) methods enable high-resolution computational mechanics simulations by exploiting low-rank structure in discretized fields and operators. While the superfast Fourier transform (SFFT) has enabled efficient TT-based spectral solvers for periodic problems, corresponding representations for non-periodic boundary conditions remain underexplored. We introduce the superfast cosine and sine transforms (SFCT and SFST), extending the TT spectral framework to homogeneous Neumann and Dirichlet boundary conditions, respectively. Building on a quantum-circuit construction of the discrete cosine and sine transforms, we derive both transforms from a shared TT operator representation and prove that their TT ranks are bounded by $6r_S$, independently of the discretization order, where $r_S$ is the rank of the SFFT at the prescribed accuracy. The measured ranks plateau near 32 for grid sizes up to $2^{26}$ points. For Rayleigh-Bénard convection, spectral pressure projection achieves up to a 7-fold speedup in the Poisson solve relative to a preconditioned physical-space TT solver while maintaining comparable accuracy. Three-dimensional computational homogenization achieves a 2-6-fold speedup and a 4-7-fold reduction in memory consumption compared with the existing TT-based approach. The results establish an efficient TT framework for spectral PDE solvers with non-periodic boundary conditions.

papers.title: LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving engines offload the key/value (KV) cache from GPU memory to host DRAM and SSD so multi-turn and agent requests can reuse prompt prefixes. Capacity then limits service at two levels: external tiers govern prefix reuse before eviction, while the GPU KV pool bounds concurrent long requests, and lossy compression alters KV values and outputs. LoomKV brings lossless KV compression to both external tiers (tier mode) and the GPU pool (pool mode) on an unmodified engine. Using a calibrated per-head two-level 3-bit code over BF16 high bytes (sign and upper seven exponent bits), LoomKV stores BF16 KV at 0.71 of its raw size across nine models and FP8 KV at 0.85-0.87. In tier mode, TileStream writes exact-length records with length readback off the load path, leaving tier storage, eviction, and prefetch unchanged, and decompresses fetched records straight into scattered GPU pages. In pool mode, FragPack packs variable-length records into smaller shared-budget GPU pages read in place by a fused decode-attention kernel faster than FlashAttention-3 on BF16. Built with LMCache and vLLM, LoomKV makes compressed tiers act as 1.4x larger raw tiers on AgentX: across LMCache's LRU cliff, tier mode delivers 2.7-3.6x raw's goodput and 1.9-3.1x lower mean time-to-first-token (TTFT), shifts the cliff identically under other simulated replacement policies, and cuts repeated-prompt TTFT up to 1.7x via SSD-to-DRAM promotion. When tiers hold the working set, pool mode fits 1.31-1.34x as many GPU tokens, admitting 12 long requests with roughly raw's queue and goodput at 8. On an AI IDE trace where both tiers and the GPU pool are constrained, tier and pool modes raise goodput by 1.24x and 1.59x. Where raw capacity suffices, compression costs at most 2.2% throughput; tier mode is bit-exact with raw tiers, and pool mode matches FlashAttention-3's numerical accuracy.

digest.summaryZh: LoomKV 通过逐头码本对KV高字节无损编码，分别扩展DRAM/SSD缓存与GPU池容量，并融合解压和解码注意力。BF16约存为原大小0.71，容量临界点可提高goodput；tier恢复逐位一致，pool注意力因求和顺序变化只保证对照中的数值精度，不能混同输出逐位一致。
digest.motivationZh: LLM多轮与Agent服务同时受外部前缀缓存和GPU KV池容量限制，有损压缩又会改变KV及输出。压缩后的字节变短不一定增加实际可分配容量，解压与散写、长度同步还可能抵消缓存收益。必须把无损编码、内存分配和传输关键路径联动，才能用较少空间换取缓存命中与并发容量。直接对应KV缓存、无损表示、GPU本地存储及分层服务系统，适合与低比特有损量化的质量成本进行区分。
digest.methodZh: 共享一套逐头无损码本，在tier模式保存精确长度对象，在pool模式用小页打包并由融合内核原位解码。BF16低字节原样保留，高字节用码本符号和逃逸编码；3-bit符号不等于3-bit数值量化。TileStream恢复到分散GPU页，并把长度读回放到加载路径外。FragPack将可变记录放入共享预算小页，融合解压和注意力，避免完整中间张量。实现接入LMCache/vLLM；tier保留原注意力后端，pool采用融合解压注意力。评测为双H800服务器，GPU池额外元数据与缓冲计入同一容量预算。把无损编码同时做成可实际利用的外部缓存对象和GPU池页，而不是只优化传输压缩率。
digest.experimentsZh: 正文VIII-A：双80GB H800，主要模型Qwen3-30B-A3B及GLM-4-9B；AgentX多轮轨迹与第二AI IDE工作负载，另测九模型压缩率。对比原始BF16 LMCache/vLLM及FP8 KV；内核另与SplitZip、ExANS和nvCOMP等比较，质量需分tier与pool口径。指标包括：实际存储比例、满足TTFT/ITL门槛的goodput、引擎TTFT、GPU可容纳token数、输出数值一致性。摘要报告BF16大小约为原始0.71；AgentX跨LRU容量临界点时tier goodput为原始2.7–3.6×，pool可容纳1.31–1.34× GPU token；容量充足时吞吐代价最高2.2%。容量临界点增益不能外推为所有负载的解码加速；TTFT是引擎时间，不含代理等待。KV存储无损不代表融合注意力输出逐位相同，pool因求和次序变化有舍入差异；结果依赖缓存和并发预算。

papers.title: RankCast: Phase-Aware Rank Balancing in MoE Serving
papers.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) inference increasingly adopts disaggregated architectures that separate Prefill (P) and Decode (D) phases. Meanwhile, Expert Parallelism (EP) has been widely adopted in large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model serving. However, load imbalance still slows down MoE inference because each layer must wait for the busiest EP rank. The main source of latency differs between prefill and decode. Prefill is compute-bound, and its MoE layers' latency is determined by the maximum token count of the busiest rank. At the same time, under moderate batch sizes, Decode is memory-bound, so the latency is dominated by the maximum active-expert count across ranks. To solve both problems under a unified framework, we present RankCast, a system that reduces rank-level maximum token counts during prefill and active-expert counts during decode. For every token, RankCast preserves the predicted Top-p experts and chooses the remaining k-p from its Top-L candidates (L > k). In prefill, RankCast yields a price per rank that steers flexible assignments to less loaded ranks. In decode, RankCast closes experts on the busiest ranks while preserving the constraints for each token. Both paths are implemented and tested in the state-of-the-art inference frameworks SGLang and DeepEP. We overlap RankCast's kernels with model execution and reuse the existing DeepEP communication channel for metadata transmission. On Qwen3-235B-A22B with EP=8 and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B with EP=16, RankCast removes over 75% of the busiest rank's excess prefill load, improves prefill input throughput by up to 19%, and reduces decode time per output token by up to 10%. The quality cost is below one percentage point.

papers.title: RegHarness: Regulating What Code-as-Policy Agents Keep from Steps to Skills
papers.abstract: Code-as-Policy agents generate, execute, and revise robot programs, but often lack explicit mechanisms to govern what persists across executions: which actions are retained within a trial and which code modifications carry over to subsequent runs. This leaves two critical aspects of agent behavior insufficiently controlled: step-level execution and cross-run adaptation. We present RegHarness, a two-level harness that governs both forms of persistence for the RATs agent team, without relying on a vision-language-action (VLA) policy or demonstrations. Within each trial, run-time governance evaluates each proposed step from a reset scene, replaying the committed steps, while a fixed-rule controller commits the step only when both RATs' verifier and a task-long LLM auditor approve it. Between runs, a coding agent uses logged failures to develop and test revisions to skills, primitives, and rules, which remain disabled by default until explicitly enabled by the authors. Using a single low-cost model across all run-time roles, RegHarness achieves an 87.8% success rate (158/180) on paired LIBERO-PRO trials, compared with 39.4% for RATs, and a 72.0% success rate on MolmoSpaces trials. A $2\times2$ ablation study of RegHarness's two levels shows that its skill refinement alone increases RATs' successful trials from 71 to 135, whereas run-time governance alone achieves 105 and RATs' native stepwise reset-and-replay mode achieves only 46. These findings suggest that, for Code-as-Policy agents operating with low-cost models, task success depends not only on how generated programs are executed, but also on the quality of the reusable skills they invoke and how those skills evolve across runs.

digest.summaryZh: RegHarness 将机器人代码Agent的单次步骤提交与跨运行技能修订分开治理：重置重放后由验证器和审计器共同批准步骤，离线修订由作者选择启用。LIBERO-PRO配对试验为158/180，但开发状态、预算和提示差异影响解释，不能把成功率全归给单个审计模块或完全自主学习。
digest.motivationZh: 代码式机器人Agent不仅会生成错误步骤，也缺少控制哪些步骤和技能改动跨执行保留的明确机制。仅重试整段程序或重置重放，既不保证每个提交步骤有充分证据，也不保证失败后技能库被适当修订。运行中错误控制和跨运行能力积累是不同问题，需要区分其收益、成本及开发信息暴露。属于Agent harness与具身控制趋势，可参考执行证据和技能持久化的边界；对芯片核心和存储层次贡献较间接。
digest.methodZh: 用双层harness治理持久化：单次试验执行验证通过后才提交步骤，跨运行通过日志驱动技能修订并由作者选择启用。从重置场景重放已提交步骤，再评估新步骤。固定规则控制器结合RATs验证器与任务级LLM审计。离线编码Agent修订技能、原语和规则，默认停用并经作者门控冻结后评测。这是机器人Agent执行与开发流程研究，未依赖VLA或示范训练；使用多角色模型调用和重放，不能据成功率推断计算硬件加速或零额外开销。明确区分一步是否应保留与技能如何跨运行演进，并用组合配置检查两层治理的作用。
digest.experimentsZh: 公开正文4.1：LIBERO-PRO的180配对任务–状态试验，另有300状态扩展与MolmoSpaces；各运行角色使用同一低成本模型别名。比较RATs、其原生stepwise replay、仅精炼技能、仅运行治理及双层组合，属于整套配置而非完全相同预算的单变量实验。指标包括：任务成功率、技能与运行治理消融、重放/调用成本、开发与测试状态差异。摘要与表1的180配对试验：组合158/180（87.8%），RATs71/180（39.4%）；技能单独135、治理单独105、原生重放46。扩展300试验为260/300（86.7%），两种比例口径不同。开发状态占配对试验三分之一，作者称技能增益为上界估计；不同配置预算、提示和证据格式也不同。离线修订有作者门控与特权信息暴露，不能表述成完全自主、无泄漏风险的技能进化。

papers.title: Knocking on Minds Door; A Mixed-Methods Field Study of a Voice LLM Companion in Older Adults Daily Lives
papers.abstract: Global aging makes digital technology important for older adults healthy aging, yet graphical user interfaces remain inaccessible to many. Voice agents based on large language models may help, but users needs and reasons for sustained use remain unclear. We developed a phone-call-style companion that initiates conversations proactively and structures calls using a persona, conversation rules, and prior-call memory (facts, insights, relationship background). We conducted a two-week mixed-methods field study with 33 community-dwelling Korean older adults (29 women; aged 67-91), collecting call logs, pre-post questionnaires, and interviews. Participants made 608 calls following a daily-use recommendation; 25 continued afterward despite turn-taking difficulties. Loneliness and depression scores decreased significantly; among loneliness subfactors, only isolation (emotional loneliness) decreased significantly. Participants disclosed concerns withheld from family and linked companionship to being addressed by name, being remembered, and experiencing emotional reciprocity. We propose personalized conversation rules, accessible interaction, and user control over frequency and topics.

digest.summaryZh: 该研究把语音LLM设计为带跨通话记忆的电话式陪伴者，观察33名韩国老年人两周使用与访谈。前后量表和使用记录呈现积极变化，但没有对照组，研究者接触和中途交互设置调整也可能影响结果。它是人机交互需求研究，不能据此证明治疗效果或AI芯片效率。
digest.motivationZh: 图形界面可能限制部分老年人使用数字陪伴技术，而语音Agent的持续使用需求与互动障碍仍不明确。只有模型能力或短期可用性测试，不能解释真实生活中为何持续通话、披露个人关切或停止使用。必须把个性化记忆、交互可及性与使用者控制放到生活场景中观察，而不是仅评价回答是否流畅。属于语音Agent人机交互应用，与LLM计算核心、量化和KV系统优化无直接贡献，适合作低优先背景归档。
digest.methodZh: 构建电话式主动语音陪伴，将人格与会话规则结合跨通话事实、反思及关系背景，再进行混合方法实地研究。在通话前组装个性化背景和会话规则。用通话日志、前后量表及访谈联合分析使用体验。分析记住姓名与既往谈话、轮流发言困难及频率控制需求。论文是应用和用户研究，已读部分没有可支持芯片、GPU吞吐、显存或推理能耗收益的实验。把持续使用和关系体验与跨通话记忆、电话交互和个性化规则联系起来，形成应用设计观察。
digest.experimentsZh: 摘要及正文第4节：33名韩国社区老年人、67–91岁，其中29名女性，两周单组前后测；记录608次通话并访谈。以前后测作自身对照，没有随机或平行对照组，也没有与其他模型或硬件进行受控效率比较。指标包括：使用次数与持续使用、孤独和抑郁量表变化、访谈主题、交互障碍。摘要报告608次通话、25人研究后继续使用，孤独和抑郁得分显著下降；这只是该单组设计下的观察，不等价于因果疗效。正文明确无对照组、研究者定期联系可能混杂，参与者来自单一中心且多为女性；第三天调整了轮次检测，系统条件不恒定。短期量表变化不能证明治疗效果或推广到所有老年人。
